note: WorldLibs overhaul task state. Status is passing or failing only. Unproven is failing. Each item carries the command that decides it.

contracts.spheres: data/spheres.json: { [libId]: { nodes: [{ id, f, w, h, kind: 'interior'|'exterior', real: boolean, basis?: string, cap, by, lic, src, yaw0?: number, links?: [{ to, yaw }] }] } }. Files: public<f>.webp (equirect, max 8192 wide) and public<f>-lo.webp (2048 wide). real:false means reconstruction and must carry basis.
contracts.catalogue: data/catalogue.ndjson: one JSON per line { id, title, author?, date?, lang?, lib: libId|null, holder, shelfmark?, kind, rights: 'open'|'nc'|'link-only', read?: { type: 'iiif'|'text'|'link', url }, thumb?, src, wd? }
contracts.hotspots: data/hotspots.json: { [libId]: { route?: nodeId[], nodes: { [nodeId]: [{ id, yaw, pitch (degrees), kind: 'object'|'shelf'|'text', title, body, tier: 'primary'|'secondary'|'wikipedia'|'unproven', source, text?: { original, lang, translation } }] } } }
contracts.dispersal: data/dispersal.json: [{ lib, holder, place, lat, lon, what, count?, tier, source, manifest? }]
